notes: Same policy form as プレミアカレンシー３ but with its own rate page and rates. Terms are 5 and 10 years only.
on_sale_date: the joint Rakuten Bank / Dai-ichi Frontier release (id=1078, dated 2026-06-15) says sales start on 2026-06-15 (2026年6月15日より…取扱いを開始).
No combined brochure is published for this edition, only the 契約締結前交付書面.

The insurer's history tables include a 2026-06-01 row, which predates the 2026-06-15 launch (its MVA values equal the parent product's), and a one-off 2026-06-15 row. Both are recorded as published; treat 2026-06-15 as the first period in which the product could be bought.
notes_en: Same policy form as Premier Currency 3, with its own rates. Terms are 5 and 10 years only.
Launch date is the date of the insurer's announcement (15 June 2026).
The insurer's history table includes a 1 June 2026 row from before launch; treat 15 June as the first real period.

Maturity-focused plans (満期重視プラン, 生存保障重視型 in the policy terms) are filed as survival-weighted annuities: the death benefit and surrender value are capped at the premium times the death-benefit share, a charge for the death cover comes out of the account, and survivors get a larger maturity value. The Basic plan stays a fixed annuity.
